This can be especially true in professional or formal settings, where dressing the part can help you feel more prepared and self-assured. Additionally, the act of dressing up can also have a physical impact on your body language and demeanor. When you wear a suit and tie, you may stand up straighter, make eye contact more easily, and speak with more authority, which can further reinforce your feelings of confidence. It's also worth noting that this phenomenon is not just about how others perceive you, but also about how you perceive yourself. When you wear clothes that make you feel good, you're more likely to feel confident and self-assured, which can have a positive impact on your performance and interactions with others.
